basic_info.description: 1901 Webster Street is a charming nine-unit apartment building in Lower Pacific Heights, just one block from the vibrant Fillmore Street corridor, offering premier shopping, dining, and retail experiences. This well-maintained property features a diverse mix of unit types, including a studio, six one-bedroom apartments, a two-bedroom unit, and a stunning top-floor 3BD/2BA flat. The units showcase classic San Francisco charm with hardwood floors, high ceilings, built-in cabinetry, and wainscoting. Many have been thoughtfully updated while preserving their character.  Key property highlights include separate gas and electric metering, individual water heaters in most apartments, and wall furnaces to provide heat. The building is in compliance with both the city's soft-story retrofit and sleep alarm ordinances.  Professionally managed and held by the same family for many years, this turn-key investment is located in one of the city's most desirable rental markets. With its prime location near the best of Pacific Heights, strong tenant demand, and significant rental upside, 1901 Webster Street presents an exceptional opportunity for investors.
